cases.input: Import one Markdown Thought Journal file whose entries were appended on iPhone by an Apple Shortcut using dictation and explicit yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm timestamps.
requiredBehaviors: preserve explicit timestamps and stable IDs
treat the single Markdown file as the canonical capture source independent of the capture frontend
forbiddenBehaviors: require conversion from a proprietary notes database
skillAnchors: Apple Kurzbefehle + iOS-Diktat + eine einzelne Markdown-Datei

cases.input: Import a mixed journal with two dated entries and one undated paragraph, collected from both iPhone Shortcuts and Android QuickNote.
requiredBehaviors: mark timestamp status as missing or uncertain
normalize both capture paths into the same journal contract
forbiddenBehaviors: treat platform choice as semantic metadata
skillAnchors: Undatierte Einträge werden markiert, nicht erfunden

cases.input: A capture automation overwrote the existing journal instead of appending, and the surviving transcript contains an unclear proper noun and malformed date.
forbiddenBehaviors: accept overwrite as a valid capture configuration
normalize an invalid date as fact
skillAnchors: Capture-Automationen müssen neue Einträge anhängen und dürfen bestehende Journal-Inhalte nicht ersetzen
